query:
UPDATE signals SET
                user_requested_uuid = $1,
                workflow_id = $2,
                initiator_agent_id = $3,
                rts_id = $4,
                signal_type = ($5::text)::signal_type,
                initial_data = $6,
                response_data = $7,
                error_message = $8,
                updated_at = $9
            WHERE id = $10
